notes:
- **Every frame reaches the screen, sooner.** RexDesk drew only every other refresh of the display (60 of 120, 30 of 60) and held each frame for two refreshes; it now shows all of them, the moment they are decoded.
- **Smoother in fast motion and quicker to respond:** decoding no longer holds up the network, keys and clicks.
- **True colours:** greys and colours arrive as the Mac drew them (they were up to 11 in 255 too light).
- **Half the data in motion, the same picture:** bits are no longer spent on detail that cannot be seen while it moves.
- **Copy and paste between your own Macs:** no more pause after a copy, and a paste right after a copy pastes it, also with Universal Clipboard on.
